searchText: Call in 15 minutes Zoom link: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09 Apologies, but the new MacOS broke my streaming setup, so we won't livestream this call (but upload the zoom recording after) When another client team has Arrow Glacier implemented, can they double check <@!211091239112671234>'s fork ID? `0x20c327fc` Are there any specific days / times usually used for breakout sessions? My availability next week is pretty flexible, so I would go with whatever works best for people (for the base fee calculation breakout session that is) monday,wed-fri work pretty well for me after ~14 CET Would have been good to have <@364458974906548225> on this call. 😖 Talk about verkle trees and stateless stuff. Mon/Tue 14 or 15 UTC work for me 😄 Mon 1400 UTC looks like a good option then, let's go with that! Perf Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/408 implementing arrowGlacier for besu, I noticed we do not have an arrowGlacier fork block for ropsten. I believe ropsten is near-deprecated in favor of sepolia, but I am wondering when ropsten will become unusable without a fork. Using the python estimating function from the london difficulty bomb EIP (https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3554) , it looks like ropsten will be begin to be unusable by late Jan? Would somebody sanity check me on this? ``` >>> predict_diff_bomb_effect(11324468, 3982581419, 9700000, 1) 0.03370118872138493 >>> predict_diff_bomb_effect(11324468, 3982581419, 9700000, 2) 0.13480475488553972 >>> predict_diff_bomb_effect(11324468, 3982581419, 9700000, 3) 0.5392190195421589 >>> predict_diff_bomb_effect(11324468, 3982581419, 9700000, 4) 2.1568760781686356 ``` if those cals are correct and we want to let the bomb go off, we should probably communicate the death of ropsten and make sure sepolia is 'production ready' by then confirmed. besu's arrowGlacier forkId is 0x20c327fc Great, updating the spec now. TY!

excerpts.content:
implementing arrowGlacier for besu, I noticed we do not have an arrowGlacier fork block for ropsten.  I believe ropsten is near-deprecated in favor of sepolia, but I am wondering when ropsten will become unusable without a fork.  

Using the python estimating function from the london difficulty bomb EIP (https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3554) , it looks like ropsten will be begin to be unusable by late Jan?  Would somebody sanity check me on this?

```
>>> predict_diff_bomb_effect(11324468, 3982581419, 9700000, 1)
0.03370118872138493
>>> predict_diff_bomb_effect(11324468, 3982581419, 9700000, 2)
0.13480475488553972
>>> predict_diff_bomb_effect(11324468, 3982581419, 9700000, 3)
0.5392190195421589
>>> predict_diff_bomb_effect(11324468, 3982581419, 9700000, 4)
2.1568760781686356
```
